verdict.rationale: Unit is a banking-infrastructure platform, and such a platform could plausibly ship natural-language operation, so this axis applies. The evidence only documents the Dashboard, APIs, components, and an llms.txt file. There is no assistant, chat interface, or natural-language command capability, and an llms.txt file for AI consumption does not count as natural-language operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
